integrity: The mathematical argument is a self-contained direct free-action criterion, equivariant collapse and covering/Euler calculation. No independent validation or comprehensive priority certification has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies fundamental group and all integral homology for quotients by binary translation codes with no Hamming-weight-two word; nonfree quotients, full quotient homotopy types and nontranslation actions are not classified. Four checked finite parameters corroborate but do not prove the general theorem.
title: Binary-code quotients of hypercube neighborhood complexes: a sharp freeness threshold and integral torsion
